reviews.title: Very limited search bar
reviews.text: Appearently it hides a lot of items online. I tried to search up a specific thing but it wasn't anywhere on the app. Even though it says it has all of the items from Amazon, target, ect, I think the searching is limited which kinda gives up the whole purpose of the app.

reviews.title: Finnicky
reviews.text: The app does not work well. You can’t add items to the same list. It keeps making me make different lists when I’m searching for items and then it doesn’t even same them. I’d rather just use Babylist.

reviews.title: This app needs to be bug tested
reviews.text: I heard about this app from my sister was excited to try it I was in nyc to watch a broadway show and we were waiting for our dinner at a restaurant when I launched the app on the public internet and tried to make a list it just went no not authorized and when I went on my cell service it just was fine and the food came so I turned off my phone to eat. now today I was adding stuff to my list on the bus and after the first two items it sent the unauthorized message again and I was only adding Mario wonder to my list maybe it just hates low bars on internet or cellular but  once I got home it still won’t work and I closed the app changed the thing I was adding to the list but it didn’t work it’s a good idea but in not in execution.
